page.terms.disclaimer.p.totem-astrology-: Totem Astrology is offered as a tool for self-understanding and relationship insight — not as fortune-telling, medical advice, legal advice, or financial guidance. Sessions and site content are for educational and reflective purposes. You remain responsible for your own choices.
page.terms.registration-roadmap.p.if-you: If you are Travis (or advising him) and preparing formal filings, these are the primary assets worth discussing with an IP attorney or the USPTO:
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.totem: Totem Astrology — primary service and system name (word mark)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.earth: Earthly Wisdom for your Journey — homepage tagline (consider as slogan mark if used consistently in commerce)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.site-: Site logo — compass / cross-circle mark in the header (design mark, if filed separately)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.websi: Website compilation — totemastrology.com as a collective work
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.anima: Animal guide library — main modal copy in the calculator (totem-details.js)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.educa: Educational pages — How It Works, Values Triangles, Yin & Yang, etc.
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.origi: Original artwork — totem animal images, zodiac wheel, five-elements diagram
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.softw: Software — calculator and connections source code (optional registration if commercial value grows)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.run-a: Run a clearance search (USPTO TESS, web search, social handles) for conflicting marks
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.choos: Choose Nice classes with your attorney (e.g. consulting/readings, educational content, online software)
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.docum: Document first use in commerce — site launch, readings sold, public promotion dates
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.keep-: Keep copies of key versions of copy and art as evidence of authorship
page.terms.registration-roadmap.li.after: After registration, update ™ to ® only on marks that were actually registered
